name: reward_correct_intermediate_steps
description: Rewards completions that contain multiple equation-based or logical step lines in the thinking process, indicating detailed problem-solving.

name: penalize_repetitive_loops
description: Penalizes completions that exhibit repetitive looping behavior (e.g., repeating the same number or phrase many times), which is a common failure mode in truncated or stuck generations.

name: penalize_early_truncation
description: Penalizes completions that appear to be truncated, either by being very short without a final answer or by ending abruptly inside a thinking block.

name: penalize_hallucinated_constraints
description: Penalizes long thinking processes that result in very short, incorrect answers, which may indicate the model is overthinking or hallucinating complex steps that don't lead to the correct result.

name: reward_final_answer_clarity
description: Rewards clear, concise final answers in the <solution> tag and penalizes verbose or unclear final answers.

name: reward_complete_thinking_structure
description: Rewards completions that contain both a non-empty <thinking> block and a <solution> block, encouraging structured reasoning before answering.

name: penalize_missing_units_or_context
description: Slightly penalizes solutions that are bare numbers without any explanatory text in the <solution> tag, encouraging more complete answers.

name: reward_step_by_step_verification
description: Rewards completions that include explicit verification or conclusion steps in the thinking process, encouraging self-checking.

name: reward_numeric_consistency
description: Rewards completions where the final numerical answer in the <solution> tag also appears in the <thinking> section, promoting consistency between reasoning and conclusion.

name: penalize_obvious_arithmetic_errors
description: Penalizes incorrect answers that are very close to the ground truth (off-by-one or simple factor errors), suggesting the model was on the right track but made a minor mistake.
